data.narrative:
SunDrive Solar is a seed-stage solar technology company in the Climate & Energy sector founded by Vince Allen and David Hu. The company has raised A$60M+ including an A$25.3M ARENA grant as of November 2025. The valuation comp universe for Climate & Energy includes one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total capital raised as a proxy valuation floor of $4M, a typical seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x implies a valuation of $10M. The peer-median method is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparable companies within the narrow Climate & Energy peer set—while eight same-sector peers exist, none met the filter thresholds for reliable median extraction, making sector-wide medians unreliable benchmarks.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8M to $12M, with a median of $10M. This range reflects limited triangulation (one method only) and should be weighted accordingly. Key uncertainties include the efficacy of the ARENA grant in accelerating commercial traction, typical burn and runway profiles for seed-stage deep-tech energy companies, and the timing and terms of the next funding event. Additional peer data or proprietary revenue/unit economics would strengthen conviction in this range.
